paragraphs.text: The elders among you I exhort, who am a fellow-elder, and a witness of the sufferings of Christ, who am also a partaker of the glory that shall be revealed:
paragraphs.original: Πρεσβυτέρους οὖν ἐν ὑμῖν παρακαλῶ ὁ συμπρεσβύτερος καὶ μάρτυς τῶν τοῦ Χριστοῦ παθημάτων, ὁ καὶ τῆς μελλούσης ἀποκαλύπτεσθαι δόξης κοινωνός,
paragraphs.translit: Presbyterous oun en hymin parakalō ho sympresbyteros kai martys tōn tou Christou pathēmatōn, ho kai tēs mellousēs apokalyptesthai doxēs koinōnos,

paragraphs.text: Tend the flock of God which is among you, exercising the oversight, not of constraint, but willingly, according to [the will of] God; nor yet for filthy lucre, but of a ready mind;
paragraphs.original: ποιμάνατε τὸ ἐν ὑμῖν ποίμνιον τοῦ θεοῦ, ἐπισκοποῦντες μὴ ἀναγκαστῶς ἀλλὰ ἑκουσίως κατὰ θεόν, μηδὲ αἰσχροκερδῶς ἀλλὰ προθύμως,
paragraphs.translit: poimanate to en hymin poimnion tou theou, episkopountes mē anankastōs alla hekousiōs kata theon, mēde aischrokerdōs alla prothymōs,

paragraphs.text: neither as lording it over the charge allotted to you, but making yourselves ensamples to the flock.
paragraphs.original: μηδʼ ὡς κατακυριεύοντες τῶν κλήρων ἀλλὰ τύποι γινόμενοι τοῦ ποιμνίου·
paragraphs.translit: mēdʼ hōs katakyrieuontes tōn klērōn alla typoi ginomenoi tou poimniou·

paragraphs.text: And when the chief Shepherd shall be manifested, ye shall receive the crown of glory that fadeth not away.
paragraphs.original: καὶ φανερωθέντος τοῦ ἀρχιποίμενος κομιεῖσθε τὸν ἀμαράντινον τῆς δόξης στέφανον.
paragraphs.translit: kai phanerōthentos tou archipoimenos komieisthe ton amarantinon tēs doxēs stephanon.

paragraphs.text: Likewise, ye younger, be subject unto the elder. Yea, all of you gird yourselves with humility, to serve one another: for God resisteth the proud, but giveth grace to the humble.
paragraphs.original: ὁμοίως, νεώτεροι, ὑποτάγητε πρεσβυτέροις. πάντες δὲ ἀλλήλοις τὴν ταπεινοφροσύνην ἐγκομβώσασθε, ὅτι Ὁ θεὸς ὑπερηφάνοις ἀντιτάσσεται ταπεινοῖς δὲ δίδωσιν χάριν.
paragraphs.translit: homoiōs, neōteroi, hypotagēte presbyterois. pantes de allēlois tēn tapeinophrosynēn enkombōsasthe, hoti Ho theos hyperēphanois antitassetai tapeinois de didōsin charin.

paragraphs.text: Humble yourselves therefore under the mighty hand of God, that he may exalt you in due time;
paragraphs.original: Ταπεινώθητε οὖν ὑπὸ τὴν κραταιὰν χεῖρα τοῦ θεοῦ, ἵνα ὑμᾶς ὑψώσῃ ἐν καιρῷ,
paragraphs.translit: Tapeinōthēte oun hypo tēn krataian cheira tou theou, hina hymas hypsōsē en kairō,

paragraphs.text: casting all your anxiety upon him, because he careth for you.
paragraphs.original: πᾶσαν τὴν μέριμναν ὑμῶν ἐπιρίψαντες ἐπʼ αὐτόν, ὅτι αὐτῷ μέλει περὶ ὑμῶν.
paragraphs.translit: pasan tēn merimnan hymōn epiripsantes epʼ auton, hoti autō melei peri hymōn.

paragraphs.text: Be sober, be watchful: your adversary the devil, as a roaring lion, walketh about, seeking whom he may devour,
paragraphs.original: νήψατε, γρηγορήσατε. ὁ ἀντίδικος ὑμῶν διάβολος ὡς λέων ὠρυόμενος περιπατεῖ ζητῶν τινα καταπιεῖν·
paragraphs.translit: nēpsate, grēgorēsate. ho antidikos hymōn diabolos hōs leōn ōryomenos peripatei zētōn tina katapiein·

paragraphs.text: whom withstand stedfast in your faith, knowing that the same sufferings are accomplished in your brethren who are in the world.
paragraphs.original: ᾧ ἀντίστητε στερεοὶ τῇ πίστει, εἰδότες τὰ αὐτὰ τῶν παθημάτων τῇ ἐν τῷ κόσμῳ ὑμῶν ἀδελφότητι ἐπιτελεῖσθαι.
paragraphs.translit: hō antistēte stereoi tē pistei, eidotes ta auta tōn pathēmatōn tē en tō kosmō hymōn adelphotēti epiteleisthai.

paragraphs.text: And the God of all grace, who called you unto his eternal glory in Christ, after that ye have suffered a little while, shall himself perfect, establish, strengthen you.
paragraphs.original: ὁ δὲ θεὸς πάσης χάριτος, ὁ καλέσας ὑμᾶς εἰς τὴν αἰώνιον αὐτοῦ δόξαν ἐν Χριστῷ, ὀλίγον παθόντας αὐτὸς καταρτίσει, στηρίξει, σθενώσει, θεμελιώσει.
paragraphs.translit: ho de theos pasēs charitos, ho kalesas hymas eis tēn aiōnion autou doxan en Christō, oligon pathontas autos katartisei, stērixei, sthenōsei, themeliōsei.

paragraphs.text: To him [be] the dominion for ever and ever. Amen.
paragraphs.original: αὐτῷ τὸ κράτος εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας τῶν αἰώνων· ἀμήν.
paragraphs.translit: autō to kratos eis tous aiōnas tōn aiōnōn· amēn.

paragraphs.text: By Silvanus, our faithful brother, as I account [him], I have written unto you briefly, exhorting, and testifying that this is the true grace of God. Stand ye fast therein.
paragraphs.original: Διὰ Σιλουανοῦ ὑμῖν τοῦ πιστοῦ ἀδελφοῦ, ὡς λογίζομαι, διʼ ὀλίγων ἔγραψα, παρακαλῶν καὶ ἐπιμαρτυρῶν ταύτην εἶναι ἀληθῆ χάριν τοῦ θεοῦ· εἰς ἣν στῆτε.
paragraphs.translit: Dia Silouanou hymin tou pistou adelphou, hōs logizomai, diʼ oligōn egrapsa, parakalōn kai epimartyrōn tautēn einai alēthē charin tou theou· eis hēn stēte.

paragraphs.text: She that is in Babylon, elect together with [you], saluteth you; and [so doth] Mark my son.
paragraphs.original: ἀσπάζεται ὑμᾶς ἡ ἐν Βαβυλῶνι συνεκλεκτὴ καὶ Μᾶρκος ὁ υἱός μου.
paragraphs.translit: aspazetai hymas hē en Babylōni syneklektē kai Markos ho hyios mou.

paragraphs.text: Salute one another with a kiss of love. Peace be unto you all that are in Christ.
paragraphs.original: ἀσπάσασθε ἀλλήλους ἐν φιλήματι ἀγάπης. εἰρήνη ὑμῖν πᾶσιν τοῖς ἐν Χριστῷ.
paragraphs.translit: aspasasthe allēlous en philēmati agapēs. eirēnē hymin pasin tois en Christō.
